skill.name: deep-search-and-insight-synthesize
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through structured multi-layer web research, source validation, comparative analysis, and synthesized insight reports.
skill.summary: Create evidence-based research briefs from multiple web sources.

security_audit.summary: Static command-execution and obfuscation signals were reviewed against SKILL.md. The command finding is a Markdown inline-code false positive, and the entropy finding is explained by readable Chinese text and formatting. A low-severity semantic finding remains because the skill explicitly directs external web search and QuickChart use.

remediation.issue: External services are part of the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before sending sensitive research topics, queries, or chart data to search providers or QuickChart.

static_findings.snippet: - 使用`Write`工具创建专业的.md文档

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (7.26 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 74 contains Markdown inline code around the word Write, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. It describes creating a Markdown document with a tool and does not execute a command.
SKILL.md is readable Markdown with Chinese prose, front matter, headings, and bullet lists. No binary, encrypted, or intentionally hidden content was found.

content.value_statement: Complex research often needs more than one quick search result. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through layered searches, source checks, and structured synthesis.
actual_capabilities: Breaks broad research questions into searchable subtopics.
Runs three layers of web research for breadth, depth, and verification.
Compares claims across multiple sources before forming conclusions.
Produces concise Markdown summaries for simple research tasks.
Creates longer Markdown reports with references and Mermaid diagrams.
Suggests HTML report layouts with QuickChart visualizations for complex topics.
limitations: Requires working web search or MCP search tools.
May send research queries or chart data to external services.
Does not guarantee access to paywalled or restricted sources.
Trend forecasts remain analytical judgments, not certain predictions.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Options
use_cases.description: Research competing products, summarize tradeoffs, and highlight credible evidence for a buying or roadmap decision.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Technical Choices
use_cases.description: Collect current evidence about frameworks, tools, or architectures and present a structured recommendation.

use_cases.title: Track Market Trends
use_cases.description: Gather recent sources, verify claims, and synthesize patterns for a planning brief or executive update.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a concise answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the current state of [topic]. Use multiple reliable sources and give me the key findings, uncertainties, and source links.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a decision table.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A], [option B], and [option C] for [use case]. Evaluate cost, strengths, risks, adoption, and best fit.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Decision Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a structured document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed research report on [decision]. Include search strategy, evidence summary, source comparison, recommendation, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze trends in [market or technology] over the last [time period]. Validate claims across sources and separate facts from forecasts.

output_examples.input: Compare vector databases for a small AI product team.
output_examples.output: A concise comparison covering hosted and self-managed options, tradeoffs, cost drivers, evidence quality, and a recommended shortlist.

output_examples.input: Research the latest enterprise adoption trends for local AI models.
output_examples.output: A trend brief with recent source links, verified claims, conflicting viewpoints, adoption drivers, risks, and near-term outlook.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether to use QuickChart for public dashboard images.
output_examples.output: A decision note covering capabilities, external service considerations, alternatives, data sensitivity, and implementation guidance.

best_practices: State the research question, audience, and decision criteria before starting.
Ask for source dates and confidence levels when the topic changes quickly.
Review citations before using the report in high-stakes decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for private data that should not leave your environment.
Do not treat forecasts as facts without checking source assumptions.
Do not request a long report when a direct answer is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an AI assistant through layered web research, source validation, and structured insight synthesis.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is designed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when search and file-writing tools are available.

faq.question: Does it browse the web?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow expects web search or MCP search tools for current information.

faq.question: Can it create reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide concise Markdown answers, longer Markdown documents, and HTML-style report plans.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive topics?
faq.answer: Use caution. Research queries and chart data may be sent to external search or chart services.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. It improves research structure, but users should verify sources for legal, medical, financial, or security decisions.
